## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Cline #14426 reasoning token double-counting fix - ALREADY IMPLEMENTED (provider)

- **What**: Cline PR #14426 "fix(llms): stop double-counting reasoning tokens in outputTokens" merged 2026-09-26 03:10 UTC (yesterday's research identified as HIGH PRIORITY NEW item). Providers report reasoning tokens as subset of `outputTokens`/`completion_tokens` (OpenAI `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`, Anthropic `usage.thinking_tokens`), NOT additional. Cline's `normalizeUsage()` extracted `reasoningTokenCount` but left raw `outputTokens` untouched, so session totals/telemetry/Harbor eval harness double-counted: once in `outputTokens`, again as `reasoningTokenCount`. Fix: subtract `reasoningTokenCount` from returned `outputTokens` (clamp at 0), compute cost from pre-subtraction total (reasoning billed at output rate). Also fixed AI SDK v4 nested `outputTokens.reasoning` shape (REASONING_TOKEN_PATHS only checked flat/details-object fields, missed v4 where reasoning at `outputTokens.reasoning`). Threaded `reasoningTokenCount` through `task.tokens` telemetry event (`captureTokenUsage`, `legacyTokenUsageFromUsageEvent`, `AgentUsageEvent`), so reasoning tokens reported separately instead of vanishing. Tests assert `outputTokens` reduced by `reasoningTokenCount`, clamp at 0, pricing-fallback cost bills full pre-subtraction count.

- **Why**: **Alexi already implemented this fix**. `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` L127-150 defines `TokenUsage` interface with `reasoningTokenCount?: number` field (L149), plus inline comment L136-148 documenting "reasoning tokens consumed during extended thinking (already subtracted from `completion_tokens`)". L661-689 `extractReasoningTokens()` extracts reasoning from OpenAI `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens` (L667-672), Anthropic `usage.thinking_tokens` OR `usage.reasoning_tokens` (L677-687), AI SDK v4 shape. L714-751 `normalizeTokenUsage()` calls `extractReasoningTokens()` (L739), assigns to `usage.reasoningTokenCount` (L741), then subtracts from `completion_tokens` clamped at 0 (L742-747): `usage.completion_tokens = Math.max(0, usage.completion_tokens - reasoning)`. Identical to Cline's fix. L862-864 `addTokenUsage()` sums `reasoningTokenCount` fields for cumulative totals. `src/core/costTracker.ts` L57 `UsageRecord` has `reasoningTokens?: number` field, L102-105 `CostSummary` has `totalReasoningTokens: number`, L323-354 `recordUsage()` accepts `reasoningTokens?: number` parameter, L407-449 `getSummary()` sums `record.reasoningTokens` into `summary.totalReasoningTokens`. `src/core/sessionManager.ts` L91 `SessionMetadata` has `totalReasoningTokens?: number`, L232-249 seeds reasoning tokens from initial messages, L674-681 accumulates reasoning tokens from streaming chunks. Full implementation already shipped. Yesterday's research (2026-09-26) identified Cline #14426 as NEW HIGH PRIORITY ~3-4h item; verification today shows Alexi already had the fix before yesterday's research brief was written (sapOrchestration.ts L739-748 normalizeTokenUsage subtraction logic matches Cline's PR exactly). **NO NEW WORK REQUIRED**.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14426 (Cline reasoning token fix, merged 2026-09-26 03:10 UTC), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts L127-150 (TokenUsage interface with reasoningTokenCount field), L661-689 (extractReasoningTokens), L714-751 (normalizeTokenUsage subtraction fix), L862-864 (addTokenUsage sum), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/costTracker.ts L57 (UsageRecord reasoningTokens), L102-105 (CostSummary totalReasoningTokens), L323-354 (recordUsage), L407-449 (getSummary), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/sessionManager.ts L91 (SessionMetadata totalReasoningTokens), L232-249 (seed), L674-681 (accumulate)

- **Category**: provider (token accounting, already implemented)

- **Size**: SKIP. Already implemented in Alexi (normalizeTokenUsage subtraction fix L739-748, full session totals / cost tracker integration L862-864 / costTracker.ts L57-449 / sessionManager.ts L91-681).

#### 2. Cline #14556 UTF-8 BOM stripping - ALREADY IMPLEMENTED (core)

- **What**: Cline PR #14556 "fix(core): strip UTF-8 BOM from cron and task spec frontmatter" merged 2026-09-27. Cron specs (`.cline/cron/*.md`) and agenda task specs (`*.task.md`) saved as "UTF-8 with BOM" (Windows Notepad) were rejected: BOM hid opening `---` fence, cron specs failed "workspaceRoot is required", task specs failed "task spec must begin with YAML frontmatter". Strip BOM with `stripUtf8Bom`, mirroring #12277 fix for other frontmatter parsers.

- **Why**: **Alexi already implements BOM stripping**. `src/utils/frontmatter.ts` exports `stripUtf8Bom()` and `readUtf8FileSyncStripBom()`. Used by: (1) skill loader `src/skill/index.ts` L12 import, L129-132 `readUtf8FileSyncStripBom(resolved)` with comment "Strip UTF-8 BOM (Windows Notepad 'UTF-8 with BOM') so gray-matter sees `---` at byte offset 0. Otherwise frontmatter silently ignored"; (2) command loader `src/command/index.ts` L13 import, L331-333 `readUtf8FileSyncStripBom(filePath)` with identical comment; (3) agent loader `src/agent/customAgentLoader.ts` L31 import, L100-102 `readUtf8FileSyncStripBom(filePath)` with comment "Strip UTF-8 BOM ... See src/utils/frontmatter.ts"; (4) rules discovery `src/config/rulesDiscovery.ts` L38 import, L224 `stripUtf8Bom(raw).trim()`; (5) system prompt loader `src/agent/system.ts` L28 import, L172-178 inline `stripUtf8Bom(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8')).trim()` with comment "Strips leading UTF-8 BOM (U+FEFF) so files saved with Windows Notepad's default 'UTF-8 with BOM' encoding do not inject invisible marker". Alexi does not have `.cline/cron/*.md` or `*.task.md` frontmatter parsers (no cron/task spec feature), but the same frontmatter/BOM-stripping pattern is already applied to all markdown config files (skills, commands, agents, rules). **NO NEW WORK REQUIRED**.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14556 (Cline UTF-8 BOM fix), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/utils/frontmatter.ts (stripUtf8Bom, readUtf8FileSyncStripBom), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/skill/index.ts L12+L129-132, /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/command/index.ts L13+L331-333, /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/agent/customAgentLoader.ts L31+L100-102, /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/config/rulesDiscovery.ts L38+L224, /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/agent/system.ts L28+L172-178

- **Category**: core (frontmatter parsing, already implemented)

- **Size**: SKIP. Already implemented (stripUtf8Bom used by skill/command/agent/rules loaders).

#### 3. Cline #14561 PHP files in code search - ALREADY IMPLEMENTED (tool)

- **What**: Cline PR #14561 "fix(core): include PHP files in fallback code search" merged 2026-09-27. When code search falls back to JavaScript scanner, default extension filter skipped PHP source/template files, so Laravel and other PHP projects invisible to `search_codebase`. Include `php`, `phtml`, `inc` (source) and `twig` (templates) in fallback filter (blade.php covered via `.php` suffix), exclude Composer's `vendor` directory from search filter and workspace file index (mirrors existing `node_modules` policy).

- **Why**: **Alexi already includes PHP in code search**. `src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts` L165-170 `DEFAULT_CODE_EXTENSIONS` set includes `.php` (L169), alongside `.js`, `.ts`, `.py`, `.go`, `.java`, `.c`, `.cpp`, `.h`, `.hpp`, `.cs`, `.rb`. L172-175 `isCodeFile()` checks extension against set. Alexi also recognizes `.php` file type: `src/init/index.ts` L627 includes `.php` in language-detection extensions, `src/core/snippets.ts` L289 maps `.php` extension to `php` language ID. Cline's fix adds `.phtml`, `.inc`, `.twig` and excludes `vendor` directory; Alexi's `codesearch.ts` does not list those extra PHP template extensions or Composer vendor exclusion. However, the core `.php` support is already present, covering the primary use case (Laravel/PHP projects with `.php` files). Adding `.phtml`/`.inc`/`.twig` and `vendor` exclusion would be incremental polish (SMALL ~1-2h), not a gap. **MARGINAL VALUE** — core PHP already covered.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14561 (Cline PHP code search fix), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts L165-170 (DEFAULT_CODE_EXTENSIONS with .php L169), L172-175 (isCodeFile), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/init/index.ts L627 (.php language detection), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/snippets.ts L289 (.php language mapping)

- **Category**: tool (code search, already implemented core PHP)

- **Size**: SKIP. Core `.php` support already implemented (codesearch.ts L169, init/snippets recognize .php). Adding `.phtml`/`.inc`/`.twig` + vendor exclusion would be incremental polish (~1-2h) but marginal value (most PHP projects use .php, not .phtml/.inc).
